shots.vo_line: I was suffering for years with tooth pain.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat sits still with his back to us; in the mirror his reflection winces harder, eyes squeezed shut and lips trembling over his teeth. The lamps glow softly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Couldn't eat.
shots.motion_prompt: The reflection in the mirror slowly bares its sore teeth wider in a pained snarl, a tear welling and rolling down his cheek, whiskers trembling. The bowl stays still. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Couldn't play.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat slowly lowers his raised paw back to the rug without touching the toys, ears flattening further and head drooping with a sad sigh. The fire flickers softly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Couldn't even sleep.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat presses his paw against his jaw and winces, shifting restlessly on the duvet and blinking wearily; his tail twitches slowly. Moonlight stays steady at the window. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: My teeth were hurting so much, I couldn't stand everyday life.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat slowly rubs his paw against the side of his mouth, wincing with his eyes squeezed shut, his whole body tensing then sagging. The lamp glows softly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Every meal, every nap, every moment, I was feeling miserable.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat lies slumped on the blanket with his paw at his jaw, blinking slowly and letting out a tired sigh, his side rising and falling. The fire flickers. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Piece by piece,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat takes two slow, heavy steps forward with his head and tail low, glancing back once at the toys and staying within the frame. The fire flickers softly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: my happiness got taken from me,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat takes one slow, heavy step, head hanging lower and eyes half closing sadly, ears drooping; he stays in place within the frame. The lamp glows softly behind. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: until I just wanted to hide and be left alone.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat stays curled up under the bed, slowly blinking his sad eyes and tucking his head a little deeper, his side gently rising and falling with slow breaths. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: It broke my mum's heart when she saw me like that.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman stops knitting and looks down at the cat with teary, worried eyes, her chin trembling; the cat gazes up at her and blinks slowly. The fire flickers. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: But she had no idea my teeth were destroying my whole life.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds his mouth wide open, his jaw trembling slightly as saliva glistens on the swollen gums and tartar-crusted teeth. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Then she started sprinkling Meow Mouth on my dinner. No brushing. No anaesthetic.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman tips the scoop and a thin stream of pale powder sprinkles onto the food in the bowl; the cat watches with curiosity. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: And after just a few weeks,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat eats contentedly from the bowl, head gently bobbing as he chews, his tail curling slowly behind him. Sunlight glows on the tiles. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: we both couldn't believe the results.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat beams with a big happy smile, his eyes crinkling, head tilting slightly and whiskers twitching. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Every meal, it worked through my saliva,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat keeps his mouth open as glistening saliva slowly washes over his teeth and tiny sparkles of light shimmer across them, his jaw barely moving. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: breaking down years of tartar and fighting the bacteria eating away at my gums,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds his mouth open, jaw trembling slightly, while faint yellow tartar on his teeth slowly cracks and flakes away, revealing clean white enamel. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: right down below the gumline, where no treat ever reached.
shots.motion_prompt: A luminous stream of clear liquid slowly flows down along the gum and around the tooth, and the small glowing green specks gently dissolve and fade away. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: My gums went from bleeding and swollen to healthy and pink,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds his mouth open showing clean white teeth and healthy pink gums, then slowly closes it into a happy contented smile, eyes softening. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: and eating finally felt good again. So I got my happy life back.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat happily scoops a biscuit from the bowl with his paw and crunches it, his tail swaying high and gently. The fire flickers. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: I started eating properly, playing, running around,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat crouches playfully, wiggling his rear and swatting gently at the feather toy as it flutters just above him, staying on the rug in his place. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: and coming back for cuddles.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman gently rocks while hugging the cat to her cheek, both smiling with their eyes closed; the cat nuzzles softly into her. The fire flickers. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: This tasty powder helped me feel like my younger self again,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat licks his lips and smiles contentedly, blinking slowly, his tail swaying gently. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: and I'm finally enjoying my senior years the way I always should have.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat slowly turns a page of the book with his paw and blinks contentedly; the wisteria and roses sway in a gentle breeze. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: But hurry! Meow Mouth is giving away a free tub with every two you order, while stocks last.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat smiles widely, ears perked, nodding happily and blinking while sitting in place behind the tubs. The three tubs stay completely still with their labels facing the camera. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: So tap the link below and claim your free tub before they're gone.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat smiles, keeps his paw on the tub lid and nods gently towards the bottom of the frame. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.

voice.voices: AK - British Posh Well-Spoken Old Man
